title: lahad pe fatima zahra kay tha bayaan amma
body:
lahad pe fatima zahra kay tha bayaan amma
<<DIVIDER>>
sunanay aae hai rudaad betiyaan amma
<<MINI>>
lahad pe fatima zahra kay tha bayaan amma
<<DIVIDER>>
1. mai karbala ke biyabaan, say aayi hoon amma, jigar pe daagh bahattar, kay laayi hoon amma, sakina bibi ko dafna ke aayi hoon amma.
<<MINI>>
lahad pe fatima zahra kay tha bayaan amma
<<DIVIDER>>
2. hai abb bhi meri nigahon, mein asr ka manzar, chalaya shimr ne sookhe, gale pe jab khanjar, tumhara laal ragardta tha eydiyaan amma.
<<MINI>>
lahad pe fatima zahra kay tha bayaan amma
<<DIVIDER>>
3. jab aayi shaam e gareeban, naye sitam toote, ridayein cheen li sar se, jala diye qaimay, pinayi abid e muztar ko bediyaan amma.
<<MINI>>
lahad pe fatima zahra kay tha bayaan amma
<<DIVIDER>>
4. kabhi thi seliyaan durre, kabhi tamachay they, rawa sakina ke kaano, se khoon k dhaaray they, sitam ne cheen li bacchi ki baliyaan amma.
<<MINI>>
lahad pe fatima zahra kay tha bayaan amma
<<DIVIDER>>
5. guzar rahe they jo raaho, se hum jhukaaye
nazar, ali ki betiyaan koofa, tha aur be-chader, harr aik simt se uthti thi ungliyaan amma.
<<MINI>>
lahad pe fatima zahra kay tha bayaan amma
<<DIVIDER>>
6. gire jo raahon me oonto, ki pusht se bacchay, nazer ke saamne maao, ki mar gaye bacchay, watan ko aaye hai khaali hai godiyaan amma.
<<MINI>>
lahad pe fatima zahra kay tha bayaan amma
<<DIVIDER>>
7. likha hai nauha jo khud nauhakhaan hai
shaokat, azaa ke farsh se paayi, hai arsh tak izzat, rahengay hashr mein hum iss ke sayebaan amma.
<<MINI>>
lahad pe fatima zahra kay tha bayaan amma
